meta.title: TB-25 JLCPCB sourcing, land patterns, fab and assembly rules
meta.provenance_convention: Every block carries 'provenance': 'READ_TODAY' (fetched and read on 2026-11-10, URL given), 'DERIVED' (computed by me from READ_TODAY numbers, formula given) or 'RECALLED' (from memory, not verified today - check before relying on it).
meta.jlcpcb_library_source: Stock, price, Basic/Extended and MPN were read from JLCPCB's own parts-library endpoints (the same data the jlcpcb.com/parts pages render): POST https://jlcpcb.com/api/overseas-pcb-order/v1/shoppingCart/smtGood/selectSmtComponentList (search) and GET https://cart.jlcpcb.com/shoppingCart/smtGood/getComponentDetail?componentCode=Cxxxx (detail). componentLibraryType 'base' = Basic, 'expand' = Extended. Prices are USD per piece at the quantity break shown. Stock moves daily.
meta.coordinate_convention: All land-pattern coordinates are in mm, component TOP view (looking at the part from above as it sits on its own side of the board), origin at the body / pad-pattern centre unless stated, +x right, +y up. For a part placed on the bottom copper layer the router must mirror the pattern itself.

chosen.jlc_msl_note: JLC lists MSL 3; the Raspberry Pi datasheet says MSL 1
chosen.do_not_use: C2961140, C2761095, C5157610, C6855416 are other RP2040 listings with ZERO stock today.

pinout.numbering: Top view, pin 1 at the top of the LEFT side (dot in top-left corner), counting counter-clockwise: 1-14 down the left side, 15-28 left-to-right along the bottom, 29-42 up the right side, 43-56 right-to-left along the top. Pad 57 = centre GND.

pins.57: GND (exposed centre pad - the ONLY ground connection)

pinout.reset_states: GPIO0-29 pull-down; QSPI_SCLK pull-down; QSPI_CSn pull-up; SWCLK, SWDIO pull-up; RUN pull-up; TESTEN pull-down (Tables 615-619).

body.note: The ePad is deliberately smaller than a generic QFN-56 (3.1 mm, not ~5.6 mm): a stock 'QFN-56 7x7 P0.4' footprint has the wrong centre pad.

land_pattern.source: RP2040 datasheet section 5.1.2, Figure 167 'Recommended PCB Footprint for the RP2040 QFN-56 package'

57.name: GND (exposed centre pad - the ONLY ground connection)

sources: https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rp2040/hardware-design-with-rp2040.pdf  (chapter 2 text + Figure 11 complete schematic, read as rendered image)

decoupling_100nF.rule: One 100 nF close to EACH IOVDD pin (1, 10, 22, 33, 42, 49), EACH DVDD pin (23, 50), USB_VDD (48) and ADC_AVDD (43) - datasheet 2.9.1, 2.9.2, 2.9.4, 2.9.5.
decoupling_100nF.minimal_design_actual: C6, C7 = 100 nF on +1V1 (the two DVDD pins); C9, C11, C12, C13, C14, C15, C16 = 7 x 100 nF on +3V3 (pins 48 and 49 share one capacitor for lack of room on a 2-layer board). All 0402 (M1005) X7R 10 %.
decoupling_100nF.total_for_full_rule: 10 x 100 nF (6 IOVDD + 2 DVDD + USB_VDD + ADC_AVDD)

core_regulator_1V1.VREG_VIN: pin 44, tie to +3V3 (1.8-3.3 V), 1 uF to GND close to the pin (C10 in the guide, 0402 X5R 16 V)
core_regulator_1V1.VREG_VOUT: pin 45, 1.1 V out 100 mA max, 1 uF to GND close to the pin (C8), and it MUST be wired off-chip to both DVDD pins 23 and 50
core_regulator_1V1.note: VREG_VIN also powers the POR/brown-out blocks so it must be powered even if an external 1.1 V were used.

crystal.recommended_part: Abracon ABM8-272-T3, 12 MHz, CL 10 pF, ESR max 50 ohm, +/-30 ppm, drive 10 uW typ / 200 uW max
crystal.circuit: Crystal pad 1 -> XIN (pin 20) with C2 = 15 pF C0G to GND; crystal pad 3 -> C3 = 15 pF C0G to GND and through R5 = 1 kohm series resistor to XOUT (pin 21); crystal pads 2 and 4 -> GND.
crystal.load_cap_math: 15 pF || 15 pF in series = 7.5 pF + ~3 pF stray = 10.5 pF vs 10 pF target (guide section 2.3).
crystal.warning: Guide: any deviation from this crystal / 15 pF / 1 k combination at 3.3 V IOVDD 'will require extensive testing'.

qspi_flash.boot_strap: QSPI_SS is the BOOTSEL strap: R1 = 1 kohm from QSPI_SS to a 2-pin header/button to GND (pull low at reset -> USB BOOTSEL mode). R2 = 10 kohm pull-up from QSPI_SS to +3V3 is drawn but DNF with the W25Q128JV; the guide says fit it if a different flash is used. Keep R1/R2 next to the flash.
qspi_flash.guide_flash: W25Q128JVSIQ (16 MB is the largest RP2040 supports); any 25-series flash answering 03h with 24-bit addressing works (guide 2.6).

usb.used: 27 ohm series resistor in each of USB_DP (47) and USB_DM (46), close to the chip; no external pull-ups.
usb.unused: USB_VDD (48) must NOT be left unconnected - tie to +3V3 (any 1.8-3.3 V supply) with its 100 nF (datasheet 2.9.4). The datasheet text I read gives no instruction for unused USB_DP/USB_DM; leaving them unconnected is my RECALLED practice, not a quoted rule. Without USB there is no BOOTSEL mass-storage path: the first program must go in over SWD.

minimal_support_circuit.RUN: pin 26, active-low reset, internal pull-up; 'If RUN is not used, it should be tied high' (datasheet 2.12.5). The minimal design just brings it to a header.
minimal_support_circuit.SWD: SWCLK pin 24, SWDIO pin 25 (both internal pull-up), plus GND; the minimal design routes them straight to the header with no series parts.
minimal_support_circuit.ADC_AVDD: pin 43: 3.3 V nominal, 100 nF close to the pin; the minimal design ties it directly to +3V3 (no filter).
minimal_support_circuit.GND: Only through pad 57 - it must be soldered and via-stitched to the ground plane.
